scope: All finite sequence lengths, including zero; Koszul-regular source; arbitrary coefficient modules. Rings and module carriers share one universe, while source and target HasExt universes are independent.

ScalarExtensionComparison requires no flatness or regularity: the actual tensor/exterior-power isomorphisms intertwine the native differential, degree-zero augmentation, and standard ordered top-coordinate cocycle.

The general exact-functor endpoint assumes finite-limit preservation of actual scalar extension and actual target Koszul regularity. The flat endpoint derives both from Module.Flat R A and source regularity. No coefficient flatness, Noetherianity, nontriviality or properness is imposed.
The localization endpoint targets the literal native quotient A/span(range(mapped sequence)), using the existing quotient tensor equivalence followed by equality of generated ideals.
native_constructions: Koszul.seqComplex, koszulAugmentation, seqProjectiveResolution, topGen and topEquiv; no replacement complex or resolution.

ProjectiveResolution.ExactFunctor.mk₀_comp_extMk_mapExactFunctor carries the original extMk through the original mapExactFunctor, with derived localization and shift comparisons intact.

normalization: mk₀(q.inv) comp mapExactFunctor_F(seqTopExtClass_R(m)) = seqTopExtClass_A(1 tensor m), where q is the actual sequence-quotient base-change isomorphism.
